newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Barito to issue 400 billion rupiah bonds.
newsitem.headline: Barito to issue 400 billion rupiah bonds.

text.p: Indonesian timber firm PT Barito Pacific Timber said it planned to issue 400 billion rupiah bonds, with a five-year maturity period and a fixed interest rate.
"The amount of bonds to be issued is 400 billion rupiah which will be used to pay bank loans," Barito said in a statement on Friday.

Barito said the bonds would be used to repay loans to state-owned banks Bank Bumi Daya amounting to 170.8 billion rupiah and to Bank Dagang Negara amounting to 198.6 billion rupiah even though the loans have not yet matured.
Acting as underwriter is privately-owned PT Makindo and the payment agency is PT Bank Niaga.
The statement did not give further details.
